The following events took place in '''7 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
[[File:Ken-PotDScover.jpg|thumb|[[Ken]], grandson of [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], was born on [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]].]]
*[[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel]] was assigned the [[6/37th|6th squadron]] of the [[37th Imperial Fighter Wing]].<ref name="RS25">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 25|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 25]]</ref><ref name="Soontir">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]'' places this event four years before the [[Battle of Nar Shaddaa (4 BBY)|Battle of Nar Shaddaa]] that takes place in [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]] according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref>
*On [[Falleen (planet)/Legends|Falleen]], two hundred thousand [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] [[Death/Legends|perished]] in a controlled [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Bombardment of Falleen|bombardment]] of a [[City/Legends|city]] ruled by Xizor's [[Parent/Legends|father]] to quarantine the spread of a [[Flesh-eating bacterium|biological weapon]]. The sterilization was overseen by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].
*[[Ken]] was delivered to the [[Lost City of the Jedi]].
*[[Daric LaRone]] joined the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]].<ref name="Allegiance">[[Allegiance (novel)|''Allegiance'']]</ref>
*The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hargeeva]] is incorporated into the Galactic Empire.<ref name="J8">{{JournalCite|8|Firepower}}</ref>
*[[Sling racing]] is introduced to [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]].<ref name="SEPG">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref>
